renderedEvidence.source: exact delivered SVG bytes rendered at 240 by 240 pixels per tile

deletionTestPolicy.releaseFinding: The motif is never necessary to understand content, evidence, state, or action and therefore cannot carry those meanings.
deletionTestPolicy.perArtifactRequirement: Record the single ijji orientation, transition, or closure job. Remove the motif when its deletion leaves ijji recognition/orientation unchanged or improves comprehension/action.
deletionTestPolicy.flatFallback: Approved identity, visible text, and whitespace preserve the complete task without the motif.

accessibilityRequirements: approved official identity and any meaningful label exist outside the motif
the exact motif is hidden from assistive technology
no state, progress, reading order, or meaning depends on color, geometry, or motion
actual artifact passes light/dark, 200% zoom, Thai 130%, forced-colors, print, no-image, and assistive-technology checks
